name: Dumbbell Hip Thrust
steps: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a sturdy bench and knees bent, feet planted flat.
Place a dumbbell across your hip crease and hold both ends securely with your hands.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips until your torso and thighs form a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes briefly at the top, then lower your hips back down under control.
tips: Finish the lift with your ribs down and chin lightly tucked instead of overarching your lower back.
Position your feet so your shins are roughly vertical at the top of the thrust.
